planning.assumptions: TIME01 duration comparison and NUM07 ordered numerals are required in frozen graph. Introduce both hand roles and Finnish puoli nomenclature; do not assume minute-by-minute reading.
planning.scope: Analogue whole/half hour, continuous hand relationship and12hour wrap; no full minute reading,24hour conversion or real-time calibration.
planning.evidenceLimits: Low-stakes reading/setting; feedback and optional hints are support, not independent retained mastery. No personal history stored.
planning.sourceVsDesign: Frozen graph provenance inherited; no new OPH requirement or efficacy claim. Story, examples, exact model bounds, controls and pedagogical sequencing are project design.
planning.assetProvenance: Original deterministic SVG. User-supplied actual transparent Aava/Loikka PNG unchanged, named in lesson, no substitute character artwork or decorative motion.

extensions.executionLimits: Supported start3/9/12, model0..60integer minutes,100ms modelminute tick (approx6seconds/hour),30min step. No autoplay; pause/reset/dispose stop timer; reset preserves paused state. Active instance owned per resolved lesson root; previous mount disposed. Current visible enum controls validated, input/change handled and check re-reads current premise; blank/unsupported does not silently become zero. New mount actively enables its own controls after previous instance disposal; synthetic and native regression retains original disabled-remount failure.
